derivations.label: landscape_rmsd_top_k
derivations.operation: RMSD over the k highest sorted ΔG of each set; k = smaller site count; sites matched by rank. HDX-NMR condition: nmr_nohis_mean.

derivations.label: dg_max_difference
derivations.operation: Highest mHDX-MS ΔG minus highest HDX-NMR ΔG. HDX-NMR condition: nmr_nohis_mean.

derivations.label: Sorted ΔG: mHDX-MS and HDX-NMR
derivations.operation: Values sorted in descending order for display.

derivations.label: Isotope distributions over time
derivations.operation: Each distribution scaled to its maximum for display.

derivations.label: Deuterium uptake, intact protein
derivations.operation: Centroid = Σ i·p(i) / Σ p(i) over mass-shift bins i; no back-exchange correction. One series per pH label.

derivations.label: ΔG per residue by HDX-NMR condition
derivations.operation: Residue i of each NMR construct is mapped to 8SKD auth_seq_id by exact sequence match.

derivations.label: Structure colored by ΔG (HDX-NMR)
derivations.operation: Residue i of each NMR construct is mapped to 8SKD auth_seq_id by exact sequence match.

derivations.label: Structure colored by log₁₀ protection factor
derivations.operation: log₁₀(k_int / k_obs) per residue. Residue i of each NMR construct is mapped to 8SKD auth_seq_id by exact sequence match.

derivations.label: Structure colored by predicted deuteration at t
derivations.operation: D = 1 − exp(−k_obs · t) per residue; single-exponential exchange, no back-exchange. Residue i of each NMR construct is mapped to 8SKD auth_seq_id by exact sequence match.

derivations.label: ΔG per residue: 6xHis, mean of 2 measurements and No-His, mean of 3 measurements
derivations.operation: Residue i of each NMR construct is mapped to 8SKD auth_seq_id by exact sequence match.

derivations.label: ΔΔG per residue, 6xHis minus No-His
derivations.operation: ΔΔG = ΔG(6xHis representative) − ΔG(No-His representative); whisker = largest range (max − min) across the measurements of a construct with two or more. Measurements can differ in labeling conditions. Residue i of each NMR construct is mapped to 8SKD auth_seq_id by exact sequence match.
